about: Measured from the render of film.mp4 (cast: paper): mattes read from the canvas each frame. state is segmented at onsets detected in these measurements, not copied from the score (score_state is kept beside it for comparison).

onsets.signal: torso matte starts moving right (> 0.8 px/frame)
head matte rises out of the crouch
head matte drops or swings away from the door
head matte swings back toward the door / rises
torso matte starts moving left (toward the door)
torso matte centre drops > 4 px (the body goes down)
head matte starts to rise and turn in (> 4 px over 0.5 s); its view becomes the back of the head
